profile.headline: Associate Software Engineer crafting cross-platform mobile apps, scalable web platforms & expressive visual interfaces.
profile.bio: Associate Software Engineer at INTTEQ with a BSc (Hons) in Computer Science (Second Class Lower Division, GPA 3.17) from the University of Jaffna. Hands-on experience building cross-platform mobile apps with React Native, Expo, Flutter, and Next.js — integrating REST APIs, PayHere & third-party payment gateways, push notifications, and publishing releases to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

highlights: Develop and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and Expo.
Integrate mobile applications with backend REST APIs and third-party payment services (including PayHere).
Implement push-notification functionality to support timely in-app user communication.
Prepare production application builds and support releases to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
Completed a six-month internship gaining hands-on commercial experience in mobile application development.
Collaborated with the engineering team on cross-platform application features and production deliverables.

experience.company: IEEE Innovation Nation Sri Lanka — Northern Province
highlights: Designed flyers, banners, certificates, and tokens of appreciation for the INSL Provincial Competitions as part of the organizing team.
Assisted with cash-counter operations and day-to-day customer transactions.
Supported account-opening procedures, pawning-related services, and daily collection activities.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science (Hons) in Computer Science
education.details: Completed honours research on YOLO-based recognition of electrical components in hand-drawn circuit diagrams (presented at SL-SWCS’25).
Physical Science stream with strong foundations in Combined Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.
Strong academic foundation across mathematics, science, ICT, and arts.

projects.title: Wasana Bakers Group Ecosystem

projects.title: BigBlast — Offline QR Ticket Scanner

projects.title: Hand-Drawn Circuit Component Recognition
projects.subtitle: SL-SWCS’25 Research Poster • University of Jaffna
projects.description: Computer vision research project developing YOLO-based deep learning models (YOLOv8 and YOLO11) to detect and classify 13 electrical components in hand-drawn circuit diagrams with high detection accuracy.
projects.more: Conducted as undergraduate Honours research at the Department of Computer Science, University of Jaffna under Dr. (Ms.) J. Samantha Tharani, and presented as a research poster at SL-SWCS’25.
teamMembers: Supervised by Dr. (Ms.) J. Samantha Tharani
features: Comparative evaluation of YOLOv8 vs YOLO11
projects.challenges: Handling wide handwriting variability and overlapping strokes in freehand electrical schematics.
projects.learnings: Object detection pipelines, dataset augmentation, and rigorous academic evaluation.
